name: Sunny Shoulders
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #7 — two wide trampoline floors over a single 580px pit, dressed with boost-only high ground: a bubblegum SHOULDER over each floor (+520) and a contested spring THRONE over the pit (+560). Introduces vertical play on a forgiving base — the fight is over whether to hold the floors or grab the throne, but every up-move needs the jetpack.

GEOMETRY: LEFT floor (trampoline x0..1510 top1080) / RIGHT floor (trampoline x2090..3600 top1080) flank ONE 580px void pit (x1510..2090). Two bubblegum SHOULDERS (left x400..720 / right x2880..3200, both top560, +520 above floor). One spring THRONE (x1620..1980 top520 h48) hangs over the pit, +560 above the floors. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -540..4140, ~540px side runway; bottom y1920 = 712px recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 580 in <0.9s; super 2800 clears all, dumps tank):
- GAP left<->right floor: x1510..x2090 = 580px over void. > 527 max spring drift and >> 395 trampoline drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the pit. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to a SHOULDER (top560): 520px above the floor (1080). Trampoline apex 270 reaches y810 -> 270px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top520): 560px above the floors AND offset over the pit (a diagonal boosted arc). Best floor bounce (270) reaches y810 -> 290px short even before the horizontal offset; under-shot drops into the pit. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; SUPER earns it fast. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: floor bottom (1208) to bottom blast (1920) = 712px recovery sky (>= 650). Verb: FLY.
- No bounce crosses the pit or reaches a shoulder/throne, so flight is required to move up or across. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
